name: Joseph Martis
abstract_title: Selective Attention and Learning Outcome Effects of Psilocybin in Mice
abstract: Attention is a critical cognitive mechanism that scaffolds learning, supports personality development, and guides interaction with the environment. Yet, it is vulnerable to implicit influences and self-limiting characteristics. Attentional differences, for example, have been linked to symptoms of depression and anxiety.
